## What this does

Production becomes hard to lose, through one scripted, idempotent,
window-gated change — `ops/gcp/protect.sh`:

- **QA-1** `sig-pg` deletion protection + retain-backups-on-delete
- **QA-2** `sig-pg` maintenance window SUN 09:00 UTC
- **B-11** `sig-pg` storage autoresize cap 40 GB
- **QA-6 / SIG-STORE-048** object versioning + noncurrent lifecycle on
  `sig-restricted` (90 d), `sig-public` and `sig-web` (30 d) — the republish
  restore point P34.17 waits on (`live:P34.3`)
- **QA-7** `allUsers:objectViewer` removed from `sig-web`, proven by site
  checks on both origins + the direct bucket URL going 403/404

Ordering inside `--apply`: pre-state capture → AR-2 on-demand backup verified
`SUCCESSFUL` → the three `sig-pg` patches → bucket legs → IAM → post-state +
`--verify` + site checks. Every step live-reads first and `SKIP`s when already
satisfied; a stop-rule trip (non-`UPDATE` op, restart, `/health` failure, site
route red after QA-7) rolls that action back inline and exits non-zero.
`--verify [--from-state DIR]` is the read-only outcome diff P35.3's probe can
reuse; `--lifecycle-file` never silently overwrites foreign rules.
